honest_assessment: With no GPU, DistilBERT fine-tuned on CPU for 2-3 epochs reaches a macro-F1(C,P) of ~0.639 (unweighted) / ~0.524 (weighted) on test. The literature reports 80-90% F1 on clean read-speech with full BERT; our gap reflects CPU-only training (fewer epochs feasible), a simpler domain (presidential speeches), and a small dataset.
